_: Santali (Ol Chiki) script of the story reel: Bodhan's draft, corrected by Dulor on 26 Nov in the editor page. 'sat' is spoken (Bodhan voice Phulmani); 'cap' is the on-screen caption, in English (Dulor: English on screen).
name: sat

lines.hi: हर सोहराय पे, ये गुस्सैल बैल खूँटे से बँधता है।

lines.sat: ᱟᱨ ᱠᱷᱩᱱᱴᱤ ᱪᱮᱛᱟᱱ ᱨᱮ ? ᱞᱚᱞᱚ ᱯᱤᱴᱷᱟ !
lines.cap: And on the post? | Hot PITHA!
lines.en: And on the post? Hot pitha!
lines.hi: और खूँटे के ऊपर? गरम-गरम पीठा!
lines._style: the surprise/storyteller takes measured flatter than this one (26 Nov), so this line keeps the advertisements take

lines.sat: ᱟᱭᱳ ᱮ ᱢᱮᱱ ᱠᱮᱫᱟ... ᱯᱩᱭᱞᱩ ᱨᱮ, ᱯᱚᱨᱚᱵᱽ ᱢᱟᱱᱟᱣ ᱢᱮ᱾
lines.en: Mother said... first, keep the festival.
lines.hi: गोगो बोली, बेटा, पहले त्योहार तो मनाओ!
lines._style: the surprise/storyteller takes measured flatter than this one (26 Nov), so this line keeps the advertisements take

lines.sat: ᱢᱚᱬᱮ ᱫᱤᱱ᱾ ᱠᱟᱸᱛ-ᱨᱮ ᱨᱚᱝ ᱞᱟᱜᱟᱣ᱾ ᱥᱤᱧᱠᱷᱟᱹ ᱨᱮ ᱟᱞᱯᱟᱱᱟ᱾ ᱜᱚᱴᱟ ᱟᱛᱳ... ᱢᱤᱫ ᱥᱟᱶᱛᱮ᱾
lines.cap: Five days. | The whole village | together.
lines.en: Five days. Paint on the walls. Alpana at the door. The whole village... together.
lines.hi: पाँच दिन। दीवार पे रंग, आँगन में अल्पना, पूरा गाँव एक साथ।

lines._: left out: the hide line starts as the ring opens, so this caption would show for one frame

lines.sat: ᱩᱱᱤ ᱨᱚᱦᱚᱲ ᱦᱟᱨᱛᱟ ᱩᱫᱩᱜ ᱢᱮ ᱾ ᱟᱨ ᱛᱟᱺᱜᱤ ᱢᱮ ᱾
lines.cap: Show the dried hide... | and wait...
lines.en: Show him the dried hide... and wait...

lines.hi: सोहराय। अब गूगल प्ले पे अवेलेबल।

lines.sat: ᱵᱤᱱᱟᱹ ᱜᱚᱱᱚᱝ᱾ ᱟᱨ ᱱᱚᱣᱟ ᱫᱚ ᱚᱯᱷᱞᱟᱭᱤᱱ ᱨᱮᱦᱚᱸ ᱠᱟᱹᱢᱤᱭᱟᱭ᱾
lines.hi: फ़्री है, ऑफ़ लाइन भी चलता है।

_style: 'style' = Bodhan's emotion style for that line (its 14 styles: fear, surprise, anger, happy, sad, news, advertisements, children's stories, single person narration audiobook, ...): the drama comes from these
